chunks: One of his proofs (peace be upon him) during the Farewell Pilgrimage is that he said: O People, I have left among you the Two Weighty Things, the Book of Allah and my Progeny, my Family, as long as you hold fast to them, you will never go astray after me forever.
ai.seo_question: What are the Two Weighty Things left by the Prophet to guide the Muslims?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this hadith within the doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility), emphasizing that the Quran and Ahl al-Bayt are inseparable companions (*Tawathun*) who will never diverge. This pairing serves as the definitive criterion for distinguishing authentic guidance from innovation, reinforcing the Shia belief in the continuous, error-free leadership of the Imams as the living interpretation of the Quran.
